copy.heading: Certificate of Reintegration
body: has successfully completed the Family Reintegration Programme, and is hereby readmitted to the household as a full member, weekends included, subject to the fixture list.
He has learned to answer a question, to find the kitchen, to read a calendar and to be back by one.
He is permitted to mention the putt on the 7th once a year, on Boxing Day, for no longer than two minutes.
